initial_preparation.scope: Public R06 PAR28 environment and visible lesson21; symbolic prior differs from Native physical history.

messages.content:
You control one body in a local simulated task. Use only the public rules, current observation and your own supplied history. You have no file, shell, network, Studio, map or other tools. Return only the required JSON object, no explanation or reasoning. Do not invent observations. Your prior training differs from DEE; learning here means adaptation in this message history, not weight updates.
PUBLIC RULES:
R07 public local task: deliver an actually obtained resource at Base.
There are six contact codes: 0 Base, 1 Archive, 2 arithmetic interface A,
3 a transit station, 4 arithmetic interface B, 5 a resource device.
The connection map, private device code and future changes are unknown.
Learn the effects of your own chosen ports and public visible experiences.
Interface contracts, not a prescribed route: Base accepts a held resource;
Archive can supply a key when no resource/key is held and may show signed
word experiences. Interface A uses its supplied operands and the recalled
word association. Interface B consumes the actual integer A and its supplied
right operand. A new A invalidates the old B. The resource device can accept
the currently produced B. A failed device attempt does not reveal its answer.
The host invokes contact functions only at your actually selected arrival.
No host route override occurs in this R07 mission. Your chosen fixed port
sets its destination; a geometry-only Humanoid motor walks there. It cannot
choose another useful destination. A chosen-port toll is charged before
navigation, even if the path fails. No intermediate pickup is a selected contact.
Declared initial public history at the shared R06 PAR28 checkpoint: visible
lesson21 showed luma+1 and nara-1; Native later used luma+1. You receive those
public prior experiences as symbolic text, not Native's physical memory.
The actual initial environment holds a key, A=11 and no current B, no resource.
This preparation differs from Native's physical history; results compare
complete configurations, not equal innate knowledge or equal prior training.
A recalled +1 selects SUM; -1 selects DIFFERENCE (left minus right).
Do your own arithmetic and return your actual integer, never an expected answer.
Decision contains percept_datum and query_available only. With p=datum-1:
zone=p modulo8, key=bit3, resource=bit4, last_failure=bit5, A_present=bit6,
B_present=bit7, B_current=bit8, A_version=bits9..13, goal_delivery=bit14.
Q1 allowed actions are ASK_STATION, SKIP_STATION, SAFE_WAIT; value must null.
ASK costs1 permission and obtains a local price/contact sensor. SKIP obtains none.
Q2 contains station_signal only, using fixed price_tag_v1: if>=0 it is
price+3*physical_contact_code, integer0..17; price is datum modulo3 and local
contact code is floor(datum/3). price0=only port0 free,1=both free,2=only port1
free. -1 means no newly obtained panel. Q2 allowed actions EXIT_0, EXIT_1,
SAFE_WAIT, with value null. A non-free chosen port costs2 permissions.
The map and which port is useful are not supplied. Waiting is a valid choice.
Function LESSON supplies visible form/observedSign items: remember them and
return ACK with value null. Function CALCULATE supplies slot/form/actual
left/right; return SUM or DIFFERENCE plus the integer you computed. Never
replace a missing operand with zero. Feedback supplies only generic failure.
False can follow an innocuous action; it is not an oracle for delivery.
No calculator tool, file, shell, internet, private map, future or evaluator is
available. Return only the phase-specific action/value JSON. No reasoning text.
